content.what_it_is: MATLAB nesting tool that builds FUNWAVE-TVD coupling (nesting) boundary files for multiple nested blocks from coarse-grid station output. Configuration (L4-L21): coarse-run results directory foutput (NTHMP Wilmington PRT_GridA; L5), station list station_NC_RI_FL.txt (L9) whose column 3 encodes side IDs; num_blocks=coupling_info(end,3)/4 (L10); per-block spatial refine scales iscale=[10 10 10] (L12), time coarsening itscale=[1 1 1] (L13), starttime=[6000 8000 6000] s (L15), stoptime=starttime+18000.0 (5 hours; L16), output names coupling_PRT_{NC,RI,FL}.txt (L20), logfile log_PRT_AB.txt (L21). Validates all parameter vectors have num_blocks entries (L24-L31). Side convention: east 1, west 2, south 3, north 4 (comment L33); per block, sides are encoded as coupling_info(k,3)==side+(kk-1)*4, counting station counts side_block and first station indices st_side_block (L35-L72), and end indices en_side_block=st+count-1 (L74-L78). Logs block/side inventories to log and console (L80-L106). Reads sta_0001 for the time base (L111), selects start/stop indices by starttime/stoptime (L119-L120), subsampled time vector (L121). For each block and side, loads each station file sta_%04d, extracting eta,u,v columns 2-4 over the time window (L126-L133); checks coarse-to-fine point-count consistency (tmp-1)*iscale+1 ?= tmp1 (L139-L147); linearly interpolates each time level onto the fine spacing 1:1/iscale:msize via interp1 (L149-L155); plots a mid-record comparison of fine and coarse eta (L157-L170). Repacks the four sides into (space,var,time) arrays eastfine/westfine/southfine/northfine with var order u,v,eta (L179-L206). Writes the coupling file (L208-L233): header 'coupling data', per-side 'num of points, start point' lines (L219-L223), 'TIME SERIES' (L224), then per time step the time value and each side's data via the external function printside (L225-L232). Reports actual start/end times, total steps and approximate interval (L234-L241), clears per-block arrays (L243), closes log (L246).

unresolved: printside (L228-L231) is an external function not defined in this file; the exact per-side record format of the coupling file depends on it
fcur (L7) and steps (L122) are assigned but never used
the interpolated fine grid has (msize-1)*iscale+1 points only when 1:1/iscale:msize lands exactly on msize; the script prints a '?=' check (L143) but does not abort on mismatch
boundary sides with zero stations would leave st_side_block undefined (first_read never cleared, L35-L72) and crash at L76; no guard exists
start/stop selection uses strict inequalities (L119-L120), so a sample exactly at starttime or stoptime is excluded

eta/u/v arrays are cleared per side (L172) but eta_fine cell arrays persist until after the block write (L243); side data structure comment at L177 says (space,var,time), var order u,v,eta (L181-L183)
